Priya (PM): Dropping a new mock for the Prompt Sets empty-run UI. Goal: a helpful tray that nudges people to get started. Mock: https://img.prod/mock/empty-run-2.png :sparkles: Alex (Design): Clean. Quick question: CTA labeling 1 'Create prompt set' or 'Create test run'? Priya (PM): We default to 'prompt set' elsewhere. But worried that 'prompt set' is jargon for new users. Alex (Design): How about two CTAs? Primary 'Create prompt set' and a lower-weight 'Run example test'. Keeps both audiences happy. Jordan (Eng): Two CTAs fine. We'll add a feature flag to hide the secondary if we see negative signal. Sam (Accessibility): A11y checklist: when the tray appears, trap focus inside and make sure focus order is logical. Provide visible focus styles. Mark the helper text as role="status" so screenreaders get the message. Marco (Frontend): Implementation notes: I'll add a focus-trap, set the close button as first tabbable, and use
for the text. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion. Alex (Design): Visual contrast: current blue CTA on muted bg doesn't meet 4.5:1. I'll propose two color tokens: solid blue and dark-pill. Priya (PM): Please add both tokens in Figma. We can A/B them. Tay (Product): UX flow: if user clicks 'Run example test' do we create a prompt set behind the scenes, or ask them to configure? Jordan (Eng): Backend prefers creating a lightweight ephemeral prompt set so the run is immediate. We'll tag it ephemeral=true and surface an edit CTA after run completes. Priya (PM): Make sure ephemeral sets are editable from the run details and marked in UI as "auto-created" so users know. Sam (Accessibility): Microcopy: avoid verbs like 'click' 1 use 'Run example test' instead of 'Click here to run'. For the button, use visible text 'Quick run' but add aria-label="Run example test". Alex (Design): Good call. We'll show 'Quick run' visually and include aria-label on the element. Marco (Frontend): Quick snippet I'll use: ```html
No runs yet 1 create a prompt set to start testing.
``` Jordan (Eng): Also: when list is empty, hide the run list and show tray full width. When first run appears, remove tray and show list. Avoid layout shift by reserving height via skeletons. Marco (Frontend): I'll add skeleton placeholders with fixed height and test large lists. Also use CSS for reduced motion: ```css @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .helptray { transition: none; } } ``` Sam (Accessibility): Keyboard flow: after a run completes, set focus to the run card heading so SR users are taken to results. Use element.focus() and announce results via aria-live. Tay (Product): Analytics events: `empty_run_create_prompt_set`, `empty_run_run_example`, include property `ephemeral_created: true|false`. Gate GA behind flag `empty_run_helptray_v2` so we can iterate copy. Jordan (Eng): We'll emit client events and backend will add ephemeral flag. GA rollout behind flag as requested. Priya (PM): Timing: Marco to open PR next week. Please review for a11y, copy and metrics. design-bot: New comps uploaded by Alex: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/prompt-sets-empty-run Alex (Design): Uploaded two color variations + keyboard nav gif. Sam (Accessibility): I'll review the PR once Marco posts. Add me as reviewer. Marco (Frontend): Will open PR: helptray component + skeleton + focus-trap + aria-live + reduced-motion handling. Priya (PM): Thanks team 1 will follow up with final copy and analytics spec in the PR. :thumbsup:
